simple.summary: אָח (ʼâch) means Oh! (expressive of grief or surprise) First listed occurrence: Ezek 6 11.

definitions.full: H253. ach III. אָח interjection (onomatopoetic) ah! alas! Ezek 6:11 ; 21:20 . ** 18:10 אָח is a vox nihili (dittograph from following אחד : see Commentaries): in 21:10 also dubious ( ᵐ5 εὖ ), read אַח Ew Hi Sm Toy, חַדָּה Co Berthol, אַתְּ Oort Krae.
